lines.en: It was a normal day, just like any other.
Until it wasn’t.
: This is really not the BGM track I want to hear this early in the morning.
: Imani. Seize him.
: Wakana, don’t you think we should maybe talk about this first? Senpai clearly just woke up and-
: Absolutely not. Seize him now.
: Uhh...Dad? What’s going on?
: What?! Shouldn’t we be asking you that question?! Why you callin’ this man “Dad” all of a sudden?! The hell happened while you two’ve been cooped up in here?!
: A lot, actually.
: Arakawa Junior, stop that. This man is not your father and has likely just brainwashed you into believing he is.
: Don’t listen to them, Ami. They won’t get it.
: See? He’s doing it right now.

: Actually, Sensei’s been standing in for my dad for a really long time now and the two of us decided it would be best if we finally took our relationship to the next level because of our undying love for one another.
: Did you really have to word it like that?
: Imani, seize him before I gag.
: Oh! So like, normal dad. Not sex dad.
: He can be any kind of dad he wants and I would never think to refuse him because I am a good girl.
: Can we forget about all of the fatherhood stuff and get to the bottom of why you two have stormed into my house trying to “seize me?”
: Not until you have been properly seized. Doing so beforehand gives you the opportunity to refuse.
: I think you’re being kidnapped.
: You are. And I’m the muscle. But seeing as you definitely don’t want to come...let’s go, Wakana! Time to leave!
: Go where? Because if you’re here to drag me back to school, you should probably do it on a day where there actually is school.
: The only school you need to be concerned about right now is a school of fish.
: ...What?
: Get in the car, you pathetic excuse for a man. We’re going to the beach.
: Wait, is it really time for the class beach trip already? Have I been gone that long?
: No. Your trip isn’t for another few weeks. This trip is for staff members only. And also Osako because she is my plus-one.
: By “staff members” she really means just us. No one else from the school is coming.
: Well...can Ami be my plus-one then?
: No. She’ll ruin everything.
: It’s sad because it’s true.
: Hey! Cheer up, Ami! At least you have a dad again. That’s more than like half the class can say.
: Please don’t joke with her like that. And please leave if you’re not going to let me bring her along.
: Please stop your moaning and be seized already. I don’t have the energy for this.
: Wakana-
: Dad, it’s fine. You can go without me, I won’t be jealous.
: Well, actually, I will. But there’s not really anything I can do about it and I feel bad that you’ll be staying back just for me.
: Stop growing up so quickly. I’ve only been a dad for a couple weeks.
: But you’ll still be one for the rest of forever so it doesn’t even matter!
: What now, Arakawa Senior? You no longer have a reason to refuse.
: Wakana-
: Just go. It’ll be fun.
: Only for one night, though. Any longer than that and you might come back to a bald daughter.
: Ugh...fine.
: Imani, seize him.
: Is the seizing really necessary if he agrees to come quietly?...
Somehow or another, I wind up getting roped into a second spontaneous and adult-focused outing after just having gone camping with Sara and company a little while ago.
However, that trip featured a lot of “building me up” since that group of friends has always been extremely supportive of me for some reason.

This trip, I imagine, will involve a heavy dose of Wakana belittling me while Imani secretly prays for me to fuck her once everyone else goes to sleep. So suffice it to say, I think it’ll be a little less poignant.
But...it has been a while since I’ve spent time with them. And humoring them with my presence (which shouldn’t be wanted in the first place), is the least I can do.
Also, in case you were wondering, the “car” Wakana referenced winds up being a taxi since none of us actually possess a vehicle.
WHICH IS GREAT BECAUSE I’LL NEVER BE ABLE TO DRIVE ONE
: So are all of the rooms at this inn just identical or?...
: We bought the “plus package” so the room came with alcohol this time.
: And if all goes according to plan you’ll also be getting a “plus package” by the end of the night.
: Hahaha! I’m going to kill you!
: Is it even okay for you to be drinking with your new medication?
: I doubt there will be any side effects from drinking just a little. And it doesn’t seem like the inn gave us much in the first place.
: Wakana, there are like thirty beers and a bottle of champagne there.
: Yes, and that’s only seven beers and about a glass or two for each of us.
: We’ll still have two beers left over at that rate.
: Wonderful job, Arakawa. At this rate, you’ll be ready to start teaching again in no time at all and Imani won’t have to break her back cleaning up after you anymore.
: Don’t mind her, Senpai. I’m doing fine and you can take all the time you need.
: Though...it wouldn’t be a lie to say that I’d like you to hurry up if possible. Not because of work specifically, though. Just because I miss having you around.
: Now kiss.
: Please don’t mind her. I know you don’t see me like that and I’m seriously not trying to pressure you. In fact, this is kind of why I didn’t want you to come at all and-
: You don’t want me here?
: Wha- no! I just meant that, like...cause you are......and I am......and sex........soooooo yeah!
: Who wants a drink?!
: You two go ahead, but do not even think of putting your hands on my seven. Or eight.
: Fifteen or sixteen counting Osako’s, as she’ll be coming to the shower with me right after putting our luggage away.
: Do you guys need anything from the lobby? Any snacks or...additional drinks if seven beers and one to two glasses of champagne isn’t enough for you?
: They sell contraception as well. Not that I’m sure either of you would bother using it.
: Wakana, leave those two alone. If they want to have heterosexual sex together, let them have heterosexual sex together on their own terms.
: Thank you, Osako! But...why did you have to be so specific?
: Pay no mind to my cat. She’s been thinking quite a bit about heterosexual sex lately. Haven’t you, kitty?
: Wakana...don’t do this....
Wakana and Osako don’t stay in the room much longer.
After grabbing their things, they exit the main hall and head to the showers, leaving Imani and me alone when I’m pretty sure Wakana directly told me she’d stop doing this.
But at least Imani doesn’t seem to be completely taken off guard by it, so...I imagine she kind of knew this was coming.
And I imagine that’s what this whole trip is for based on how we were immediately left alone next to a bottle of champagne with a huge heart on it.
: I’m...sorry about Wakana. She’s been kind of...off lately.
: Off how?
: Uh...we kind of said we weren’t going to talk about that this weekend. But all you really need to know is she’s been...working kind of hard.
: Like...really hard. And not just at school.
: So that’s why she’s decided to start trying to hook us up again? Because she’s...off?

: Oh, I don’t think that’s it. I think that’s kind of just a...thing she’s doing to distract herself from the real reason we came all the way out here. You know...to like, keep the mood light and whatnot.
: Isn’t the reason we came all the way out here to enable one more situation for the two of us to finally sleep together?
: What? No, that’s not it at all. And frankly, I didn’t really want to come either.
: I’m...not sure I follow.
: Wakana and Osako are kinda, like...fighting lately. And Osako threw this trip together to try and, like...put an end to that or something.
: Which is why I’m thankful you’re here since I didn’t want to be the third wheel. But I also feel bad about you getting dragged into it, so...
: I guess let’s just...try and have some fun, okay? And not get in their way too much...
: Do you really need to keep laying the pressure on Imani like that? I thought the whole thing with her and Akira was, like...a sensitive topic?
: It’s only sensitive because Arakawa is a fucking coward who’s been habitually abused for so long that he wouldn’t know a “good” partner if they slapped him across the face.
: Do good partners hit each other now?
: Sometimes. When the mood is right. Is that what we should try to get me off next? Or do you still prefer the idea of me fucking someone else?
: Wakana, I said I was sorry about that. I really don’t know what else I can do. But you haven’t been great either lately and you know it.
: Yes, it appears we’ve both been rather unpleasant as of late. Here’s hoping that fifteen or sixteen beers collectively can fix it.
: It’s less about the beer and more just about being here. It’s...weird going from having sex multiple times a day to barely ever at all.
: Which is why we should focus our efforts on getting our friends to sleep together instead. They can prosper while the two of us only get wet while we’re showering together.
: We could maybe, like...do it here?
: With people around? This is no train station bathroom, Osako. Getting caught here could put my career in jeopardy.
: I mean...so could fooling around in your office and we used to do that like every single week.
: I can lock my office. I can not lock the outside world.
: If you don’t want to do it, just say so. You don’t have to beat around the bush.
: What bush? You shaved just yesterday, did you not?
: Wakana-
: I don’t want to do it.
: Is it...still because you’re mad at me?
: It’s nothing that exciting. My new medication is likely just sodomizing my libido. But in the less fun sort of way.
: Can you maybe stop taking it then?
: I’ll have to find a new one. I could stop. But sexual disinterest is preferable over “excruciating back pain while also being horny.”
: Besides, it’s not as if we can just fuck away our issues. We’re not in college anymore.
: I know...that’s why I’m trying to figure this out. I love you, Wakana. And it’s weird fighting. Especially over something so small...
: Small?
: I didn’t mean it like that...
: Would it be small if I were to suggest you go and fuck Imani since I’m not feeling up to it today? Or do you think that maybe suggesting infidelity isn’t the best way to handle that?
: Babe! You never cum! Like, ever! And that seriously fucks with me. I just don’t want you being unhappy! That’s the whole reason I suggested it. It’s not like I actually want that.
: And it’s not like I actually want you to fuck Imani. But she could use the relief since Arakawa’s a pussy and you need the morale boost.
: What do you want me to do, Wakana? Just tell me.
: I don’t know...It’s not as if I’m holding that information hostage. I seriously don’t know.
: I’ve become more present for you, have I not?
: Like...yes, I’m still not as present as I once was. But my mind is wrapped up in something at the moment and it involves the well-being of a dear friend. So, I apologize for that...
: But Osako...really? Did you really think that would be the solution to the ridiculous notion you concocted that you’re somehow not enough for me? Giving me up? Really?
: I just want you to be happy-
: Then grow a fucking spine! Jesus Christ!
: This bullshit, unwarranted insecurity of yours needs to fucking end, Osako! Be a God damn woman for Christ’s sake!
: All I have ever done is love you. All I’ve ever done is try to make you feel like you’re enough, because you are.
: But no matter what I do, you still don’t see it.
: And if after all this time, I can’t make you feel complete...
: Maybe you’re the one who needs someone else?...
